name: Blast Mine's Remote Detonation casts and explodes on a live mine (#5759, #5868)
contract: Remote Detonation 801798 carries CasterAuraSpell = 500354 'Bomb Ready' in Spell.dbc, so Spell::CheckCast rejects the cast with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE unless the Tinker holds that aura. The deployed Blast Mine 50045 casts 500354 on itself as SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER, which AzerothCore's area-aura target map fills with the applying unit's owner, so the Tinker gains 500354 while within 60 yd of a live mine and 801798 is auto-granted by AscensionTinker::Refresh while a mine exists. Casting 801798 then reaches npc_ascension_tinker_device::DoAction(1), which calls Explode(): it casts Remote Bomb Explosion 802336 (Fire) on nearby valid enemies within the mine's 8 yd radius and despawns the mine. This scenario deploys a mine 1 yd from a hostile golem, confirms the Tinker gains 500354 and 801798 without ever manually learning either, casts 801798, and asserts the mine despawns, the golem takes damage and 500354 is lost once the mine is gone.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Remote Detonation is not known before any mine exists
Deploy the mine 1 yd from the golem
The live mine grants the Tinker Bomb Ready
Remote Detonation is auto-granted while a mine is live
Remote Detonation triggers the live mine
Remote Detonation actually damages the golem next to the mine
Bomb Ready is lost once its mine is gone
